name: Air Arabia PJSC
summary: Operating alongside its subsidiaries, Air Arabia PJSC offers a comprehensive range of air travel services, structured into two primary divisions: Airline and Other. Core offerings include international commercial flights, aircraft leasing, passenger conveyance, and freight logistics. The company also provides aviation training, aircraft maintenance and repair, and engages in the sale of aircraft and associated components. Beyond aviation, Air Arabia runs travel and tourism agencies, acts as a representative office for other airlines, handles lease agreements, offers document transfer solutions, and supplies IT services specifically for the aviation sector. The company further extends its activities to managing hotels and restaurants, providing both in-flight and retail catering, and operating serviced hotel apartments. Its extensive network covers around 170 locations spanning the Middle East, North Africa, Asia, and Europe. Established in 2003, its corporate headquarters are located in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates.

name: Al Mal Capital PSC - Al Mal Capital REIT
summary: Al Mal Capital REIT is a closed-ended property fund, headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, specializing in the acquisition and management of income-producing real estate. Its portfolio targets various sectors, including educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and industrial properties. The fund's investments span across the United Arab Emirates and the wider Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region, with the goal of delivering attractive annual returns to its unitholders primarily through dividend distributions.

name: Aramex PJSC
summary: Aramex PJSC engages in providing logistics and transportation solutions. It operates through the following segments: International Express, Freight Forwarding, Domestic Express, Logistics, and Other Operations. The International Express segment delivers small packages across the globe to both retail and wholesale customers. The Freight Forwarding segment includes express delivery of small parcels as well as pick up and deliver of shipments within the country. The Logistics segment covers warehousing activity, distribution management, supply chain management, inventory management and other value-added services. The Other Operations segment provides catalogue shipping services, document storage, airline ticketing and travel, visa services and publication and distribution services. The company was founded by Fadi Ghandour and William Kingson in 1982 and is headquartered in Dubai, the United Arab Emirates.

name: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (PJSC)
summary: Established in 1959 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, the Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (PJSC) functions as a comprehensive utility provider. Its primary mandate involves generating, transmitting, and distributing electricity, alongside managing water desalination, transmission, and distribution, serving residential, commercial, industrial, and governmental clients across Dubai. Operating through four segments—DEWA, EMPOWER, IPP, and Others—the company's extensive activities extend beyond its core utility services. These encompass the provision and upkeep of cooling plants, the development, operation, and maintenance of power and water facilities under an independent water producer (IPP) model, and the purification and sale of potable water. Furthermore, DEWA offers a broad spectrum of technology and infrastructure solutions. This includes IT infrastructure, networking, computer system housing, and data entry, as well as communication equipment, software design, data classification and analysis, and data center co-location services. The company also manages and operates satellites, providing related services such as space situational tracking, monitoring, and awareness, alongside the installation of wired and wireless communication systems. Its diversified portfolio also features the installation and maintenance of air conditioning, ventilation, and air filtration systems; project development and consulting; and the operation and maintenance of desalination and sewage treatment plants. DEWA is additionally involved in implementing electronic parking management systems, investing in and managing commercial, industrial, retail, and energy ventures, implementing energy efficiency measures in buildings, and manufacturing insulated pipes. The company also delivers engineering consultancy for energy projects, trades carbon control systems, and provides rental and installation services for solar energy systems.

name: Deyaar Development PJSC
summary: Deyaar Development PJSC, together with its associated companies, specializes in the investment, construction, and ongoing management of properties, with operations spanning the United Arab Emirates and international markets. The company strategically organizes its activities into three primary divisions: property development, the management of existing properties and facilities, and ventures related to the hospitality sector. The firm offers comprehensive facility maintenance and property management solutions for a diverse range of residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects, serving property owners, investors, and tenants. Additionally, its extensive service portfolio encompasses various real estate services, community administration, asset oversight, hotel operations, leasing arrangements, infrastructure and leisure provisions, climate control systems, brokerage, and a full spectrum of hospitality support, including the rental of hotels and serviced apartments. Established in 2002, Deyaar Development PJSC maintains its headquarters in Dubai, UAE.

name: Dubai Financial Market P.J.S.C.
summary: Dubai Financial Market P.J.S.C. (DFM) is the entity responsible for operating Dubai's stock exchange and its associated clearing house. The company offers a range of financial instruments, including equity futures, real estate investment trusts (REITs), and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). DFM also provides iVESTOR, a digital solution designed to enable investors to receive their due dividends electronically. Beyond its exchange functions, DFM delivers various services to its members, investors, and issuers, and supplies critical market data. The company further operates as a holding and trust entity with interests spanning commercial, industrial, and agricultural sectors, and offers financial investment consultancy and brokerage services. Founded in 2000, DFM is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and operates as a subsidiary of Borse Dubai Limited.

name: Dubai Islamic Bank P.J.S.C.
summary: Dubai Islamic Bank P.J.S.C., along with its subsidiaries, delivers a comprehensive array of corporate, retail, and investment banking services both within the United Arab Emirates and globally. Its diverse operations are structured into five main divisions: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, Real Estate Development, and Others. The Consumer Banking segment handles deposits and offers various personal financial products such as consumer murabahas, salam, home finance, ijarah, credit cards, and fund transfer facilities, in addition to specialized priority banking and wealth management solutions. For corporate and institutional clients, the Corporate Banking segment provides current accounts, deposit services, cash and risk management products, and a range of financing and credit facilities. The Treasury segment is responsible for managing the bank's treasury functions. Engaging in property development and a variety of real estate investment initiatives is the purview of the Real Estate Development segment. Lastly, the "Other" segment encompasses investment banking services. The bank further extends its services to include brokerage, Islamic finance advisory, labor services, property management, outsourcing, marketing, consultancy, printing, investment, and vehicle trading services. Founded in 1975, Dubai Islamic Bank P.J.S.C. is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

name: Dubai Investments PJSC
summary: Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Dubai, UAE, Dubai Investments PJSC operates as a diversified holding company. Through its subsidiaries, it engages in manufacturing, construction contracting, a broad range of services, property development, and investment activities. While its primary operations are in the United Arab Emirates, the company also has an international presence. Its industrial ventures include manufacturing and supplying construction materials like raw and architectural glass, aluminum extruded products, and laboratory furniture, as well as executing construction projects. The service portfolio extends to district cooling, investment banking, asset management, financial investments, healthcare, information technology, and education. Furthermore, Dubai Investments develops real estate for sale and lease, and participates in the edible oil market.

name: Emirates Integrated Telecommunications Company PJSC
summary: Emirates Integrated Telecommunications Company PJSC, established in 2005 and headquartered in Dubai, UAE, is a key provider of diverse telecommunication services, primarily serving the United Arab Emirates. The company's operations are divided into four main segments: Mobile, Fixed, Wholesale, and Others. Its Mobile division delivers essential mobility solutions to both businesses and individual consumers, encompassing mobile voice and data, digital content, mobile broadband Wi-Fi, and the sale of mobile handsets. The Fixed segment offers wireline services, such as broadband, IPTV, and IP/VPN business internet and telephony, to its enterprise and consumer client base. The Wholesale segment caters to national and international carriers and operators, providing voice and SMS services, including the termination of inbound international voice traffic and global hubbing. The "Others" segment covers broadcasting, international roaming, and site-sharing services. Beyond these core offerings, the company also engages in software development, IT infrastructure management, public networking, computer systems housing, outsourcing, and value-added telecommunications services, while also functioning as a telecommunications reseller and third-party provider. All services are offered under the well-known "du" and "Virgin Mobile" brands.

name: Emaar Properties PJSC
summary: Emaar Properties PJSC, a prominent international real estate enterprise headquartered in Dubai, UAE, leverages its subsidiaries to specialize in property investment, development, and comprehensive development management. The company's operations are structured into three main divisions: Real Estate; Leasing, Retail, and Related Activities; and Hospitality. The Real Estate segment focuses on creating, marketing, and managing a diverse portfolio of properties, including condominiums, villas, commercial units, and undeveloped land. The Leasing, Retail, and Related Activities division is responsible for developing, leasing, and overseeing shopping malls, as well as various retail, commercial, and residential spaces. Meanwhile, the Hospitality segment develops, owns, and/or manages hotels and serviced apartments, also encompassing leisure-related ventures. Beyond these core business areas, Emaar provides a range of additional services such as shopping mall and retail management, general hospitality services, property management, and utility services. The company further diversifies its portfolio by investing in financial service providers and engaging in entertainment activities. Emaar was founded in 1997.

name: Emaar Development PJSC
summary: Emaar Development PJSC, along with its associated companies, primarily engages in the construction and direct sale of residential and commercial properties across the United Arab Emirates. The firm also provides property development management solutions. Furthermore, its operations encompass the acquisition and divestiture of real estate and land, the leasing and oversight of its owned property assets, and strategic investments in commercial ventures and their administration. Established in 1997 with its corporate headquarters located in Dubai, UAE, the company was previously known as Emaar Development LLC. It functions as a subsidiary of Emaar Properties PJSC.

name: Emirates NBD Bank PJSC
summary: Emirates NBD Bank PJSC, founded in Dubai, UAE, in 1963, and operating as a subsidiary of the Investment Corporation of Dubai, delivers a wide array of banking and financial services. These include corporate, institutional, retail, treasury, and Islamic banking across its various entities. For government and corporate customers, the bank supplies current and savings accounts, customer deposits, overdraft facilities, trade finance, and term loans, along with investment banking, structured financing, and Islamic financial products. Retail clients are offered loans and deposits, private banking, wealth management, equity broking, asset management, and consumer financing solutions. Furthermore, the company manages call center operations, real estate, and trust administration, and engages in medium-term borrowing and money market transactions. Its extensive geographical reach includes operations in the United Arab Emirates, Egypt, India, Turkey, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Austria, Germany, Russia, and Bahrain, complemented by offices in China and Indonesia.

name: Emirates Refreshments (P.S.C.)
summary: Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, Emirates Reem Investments Company PJSC is a diversified enterprise primarily involved in the production, distribution, and sale of a range of beverages and dairy items. This includes mineral water, carbonated and non-carbonated soft drinks, various juices, and evaporated milk. The company also extends its operations to manufacturing plastic bottles and containers. Its products reach consumers across the United Arab Emirates, the wider Middle East, and Africa, primarily under the Jeema and AL REEM brands. Founded in 1980, the company was previously known as Emirates Refreshments (P.S.C.) before officially rebranding to Emirates Reem Investments Company PJSC in August 2023.

name: Etihad Energy Holding P.J.S.C.
summary: Etihad Energy Holding PJSC engages in engages in sea transport of oil and petroleum products and similar commodities, ship charter, shipping lines of freight and passenger transportation, sea freight and passenger charters, shipping services, sea shipping lines agents, clearing and forwarding services, cargo loading and unloading services, cargo packaging, sea cargo services, and ship management operations through its subsidiaries. It operates through the following segments: Vessel Owning and Chartering, Ship Management, Marine Products Sales and Distribution, Shipping and Technical Services, and Other. The Vessel Owning and Chartering segment deals with the chartering of vessels to customers. The Ship Management segment handles technical management of vessels. The Marine Products Sales and Distribution segment includes trading of goods such as supplies, chemicals, and gases required for ship. The Shipping and Technical Services segment provides agency services to ships calling at ports, and providing workshop services for boats. The Other segment refers to the management of all divisions and administrative activities. The company was founded by Ghazi Abdulrahim A. Al-Ibrahim, Nasser Baker M. Al-Qahtani, Fahad Sunetan Al-Otaibi, Abdullah Abdulrahman A. Al-Shuraim, Hazza Al-Qahtani, and Anis Issa Mohamed Al-Zadjali on March 15, 2003 and is headquartered in Dubai, the United Arab Emirates.

name: GFH Bank B.S.C.
summary: GFH Financial Group BSC functions as a wholesale investment bank specializing in Islamic finance, offering investment advice and transaction facilitation across the GCC, MENA region, Asia, North America, and other global markets. Its activities are segmented into Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, and Proprietary & Treasury. The Investment Banking division focuses on private equity and asset management, alongside Islamic asset-backed and equity capital market solutions, Sharia-compliant financial guidance, and mid-tier mergers and acquisitions. Through its Commercial Banking segment, the company delivers commercial, corporate, and retail banking services, wealth management, structured investment products, and project funding. The Proprietary & Treasury segment manages treasury operations and handles residual and co-investment assets. Furthermore, GFH is engaged in real estate development and investment, hospitality management, and educational institution operations, in addition to owning and leasing properties. The company, initially known as Gulf Finance House BSC, was established in 1999 and is based in Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain.

name: Mashreqbank PSC
summary: Mashreqbank PSC is a prominent financial institution delivering a broad spectrum of banking and financial solutions to both individual clients and small-to-medium-sized businesses. Its Wholesale division caters to corporate and commercial entities, offering specialized services such as trade, contracting, and project finance, investment banking advisory, cash management, correspondent banking, and Sharia-compliant products. The Retail segment provides a comprehensive array of personal banking options, including current, savings, and fixed deposit accounts (like the distinct Mashreq Millionaire deposits). It also extends various lending facilities such as personal, auto, mortgage, and business loans, alongside credit and debit cards. Additional retail services encompass bank assurance, overdrafts, priority banking, SME banking, private wealth management, and Islamic financial products. Within its Treasury & Capital Markets operations, the bank facilitates transactional services across foreign exchange, derivatives, margin FX, futures, and hedging. It also deals in investment products, domestic equities, and asset management, in addition to engaging in proprietary trading and investment activities. Beyond traditional banking, Mashreqbank's Insurance and Other segments offer an extensive suite of insurance products, covering life, health, motor, marine cargo and hull, aviation, fire and general accident, engineering, liability, and personal lines. Furthermore, the company is involved in reinsurance, brokerage, employment services, trading, special purpose vehicles, payment processing, asset and fund management, general finance, and IT services. Established in 1967 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, Mashreqbank PSC operates an international network of branches across the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait, Egypt, Hong Kong, India, Qatar, Pakistan, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

name: National Cement Company PSC
summary: National Cement Company (Public Shareholding Co.) engages in the manufacture and sale of cement and related products in the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company offers ordinary Portland, high and medium sulphate resisting Portland, and ground granulated blast furnace slag products for a range of construction applications, including residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects; and clinkers. It also invests in securities and properties. National Cement Company (Public Shareholding Co.) was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Dubai, the United Arab Emirates.

name: Parkin Company PJSC
summary: Parkin Company P.J.S.C. is dedicated to managing and providing paid parking facilities and related services throughout Dubai. Its diverse array of parking solutions extends to public street-level and off-street zones, multi-level parking structures, and spaces situated within developer-owned properties. The company also offers essential services such as permits, seasonal parking subscriptions, and advance booking options for reservations, among other supplementary provisions. Established in 1995, Parkin maintains its corporate headquarters in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

name: Salik Company P.J.S.C.
summary: Salik Company PJSC oversees the entire process of Dubai's road toll system, from their initial design and construction to ongoing operation and maintenance. The company currently manages eight of these vital infrastructure points throughout the emirate. Established in 2022, its principal place of business is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

name: Spinneys 1961 Hold
summary: Spinneys 1961 Holding plc is a retail group that primarily manages and operates grocery supermarkets, including those under the Spinneys, Waitrose, and Al Fair brands. Its operations span the United Arab Emirates, Oman, and other international markets. Beyond its core retail ventures, the company's activities are diversified, encompassing the import, export, and wholesale of various foodstuffs, groceries, and non-food consumer products. It also engages in the in-house production of bakery items and processes meat specifically for its supermarkets. Additionally, Spinneys develops and markets its own private label product lines, such as SpinneysFOOD, SpinneysHOME, SpinneysWELLNESS, and Fine Food, and offers its products through an online sales channel. Founded in 1924, Spinneys 1961 Holding plc is based in Dubai, UAE, and functions as a subsidiary of Al Seer Group LLC.

name: National Central Cooling Company PJSC
summary: National Central Cooling Company PJSC, known as Tabreed, along with its subsidiaries, delivers extensive cooling solutions throughout the United Arab Emirates and on an international scale. Its business is organized into two core segments: Chilled Water and Value Chain Business. The Chilled Water division is responsible for the construction, ownership, assembly, installation, ongoing operation, and maintenance of various cooling and air conditioning systems. This segment also manages the distribution and sale of chilled water for district cooling purposes, as well as the operation and upkeep of its plants. Within the Value Chain Business, the company undertakes the construction of secondary networks, manufactures pre-insulated pipes, markets chilled water-related products, and provides services focused on improving building energy efficiency. Additionally, Tabreed offers a suite of services including commissioning, engineering, water treatment, and design and supervision consultancy, alongside handling the billing and collection of chilled water charges. Incorporated in 1998, the company is headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

name: Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company
summary: Established in 1987 and headquartered in Dubai, UAE, Union Properties Public Joint Stock Company (UPP.AE) operates as a diversified enterprise primarily engaged in the real estate sector across the United Arab Emirates. The company actively participates in the investment, development, management, upkeep, and sale of a broad array of properties, encompassing residential, commercial, industrial, and leisure projects. Its operational framework is divided into four main segments: Real Estate Property Management, Contracting Activities, Investment Operations, and the Provision of Goods and Services. Beyond its core property ventures, Union Properties provides a wide range of complementary services and products. This includes executing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) contracts for various construction endeavors, alongside offering comprehensive facilities management solutions. The company also manufactures central air-conditioning equipment and assembles firefighting apparatus. Furthermore, it trades in an assortment of items such as firefighting and safety equipment, air conditioners, pumps, engines, valves, spare parts, water heaters, and lighting equipment. Its specialized services extend to security and energy management, as well as providing construction, management, and consultancy expertise for motor racing tracks and their associated infrastructure. Union Properties' activities also include interior decoration manufacturing, operating cold storage facilities, and offering property-related services to external clients. The company also strategically invests in equities, educational enterprises, and management facilities.
